taglines: Three prides hold the valley. There is room for a fourth.
Alone, you are prey. Together, you are a legend.
Long teeth. Long winters. Longer memories.
Every pride began with one cat who refused to die.
The herds move. The snow comes. The pride endures.
Your blood will outlive your name.
Before the stars had names, the sabretooths sang to them.
Hunt well. Choose well. Your cubs will remember both.

storytellerModes.name: Online Storyteller
storytellerModes.description: The richest stories. Every event is written fresh for your pride as you play. Needs an internet connection.

storytellerModes.name: Local Storyteller
storytellerModes.description: Stories are written by an AI model running on your own computer. Works offline, but needs a capable PC and may be slower.

storytellerModes.name: Classic Storyteller
storytellerModes.description: Uses a hand-written library of events. No AI and no internet needed. Fast and dependable, with less variety.

difficulties.name: Permadeath
difficulties.description: When your cat dies, the story ends. One life, one legend.

difficulties.name: Play On as Heir
difficulties.description: When your cat dies, you continue as your closest kin in the pride. If no heir is left, your legacy ends.

difficulties.name: Sandbox
difficulties.description: A gentler world with no game over. Explore, experiment, and tell the story you want at your own pace.

sandboxPanel.title: Sandbox Options
sandboxPanel.note: These choices are locked once the run begins. Sandbox runs stay Sandbox runs.

options.name: Hunger and Thirst
options.description: How quickly your cats grow hungry, thirsty, and tired.
descriptions: Your cats never go hungry or thirsty. Hunt for the story, not to survive.
Needs drop slowly, leaving plenty of time between meals.
Needs drop at the usual pace of the Ice Age.

options.name: Dangers
options.description: How often predators, rivals, storms, and other threats find your pride.
descriptions: No attacks or disasters. The valley is peaceful.
Threats appear now and then, with time to recover between them.
Threats come as often as they would in the wild.

options.name: Starting Reputation
options.description: How the prides see you when you first arrive.
descriptions: The prides distrust you. Mates and allies come hard.
The prides don't know you yet.
Your name is known and welcome.

options.name: Free Cat Customization
options.description: Unlock every look and personality option for your cat.
descriptions: All traits unlocked, including rare ones.
Common traits only, as in a normal run.

options.name: Free Perk Respec
options.description: Swap your cat's perks whenever you rest, as often as you like.
descriptions: Swap any perk whenever you rest. Nothing is set in stone.
Perk choices are permanent, as in a normal run.

strings.map.region.ice_wall.description: Blue ice towers above the scree, and the wind carries the deep cracks of the glacier. Even in sunlight, the cold reaches through your coat.
strings.map.region.highcrag.description: Dry caves overlook the upper river, with wind-scoured meadows below. Old pride scents linger on the sheltered stone.
strings.map.region.bonefield.description: Herd trails cross open grass between the bones of mammoths. There is little cover here, and distant hunters are easy to see.
strings.map.region.mistwood.description: Pine roots sink into marsh, and narrow trails disappear into fog. Deer scent drifts between the trunks, mingled with the scent of other cats.
strings.map.region.greywater_ford.description: Hoofprints crowd the shallow crossing, where the river keeps moving even in winter. Rival scent marks cover the banks.
strings.map.region.split_rock.description: A great cracked boulder rises above the grass, its base marked by cats from across the Vale. No pride claims this old meeting ground.
strings.map.region.drowned_mere.description: Reeds fringe the wide, still water, and geese call across the shallows. In spring, ice can hold its shape long after it has lost its strength.
strings.map.region.tar_seeps.description: Black pools lie between patches of trampled earth, thick with the smell of trapped prey. Carrion draws you closer; the ground gives beneath your paws.
strings.map.region.bears_throat.description: The gorge narrows between cold stone walls, carrying a heavy bear scent. Claw marks score the rock beside the den.
strings.map.region.ash_hills.description: Dry slopes rise beyond the grasslands, crossed by camel trails in summer. Wolf tracks follow the ridges, and their scent marks warn you away.
strings.map.region.frost_tongue.description: A low tongue of glacier ice stretches towards the foothills. Meltwater runs beneath its cloudy crust, and loose snow waits on the slopes above.
strings.map.region.blue_caves.description: Blue light filters through hollows in the ice. Their mouths offer shelter from the wind, but the cold remains deep inside.
strings.map.region.wind_scree.description: Loose stones cover the exposed slope, with little grass between them. The wind carries scent away before you can follow it.
strings.map.region.north_pass.description: A high gap cuts through the mountains, narrowing beneath steep snowfields. The route is long, and falling snow can bury the trail.
strings.map.region.horse_meadows.description: Horses graze the wind-swept meadows above the river. Low folds in the ground offer cover to a patient hunter.
strings.map.region.upper_greywater.description: The upper river runs fast between stony banks. Hoofprints crowd the shallows, though spring floods can wash a trail away overnight.
strings.map.region.salt_flats.description: Pale crust stretches between sparse tufts of grass. Tracks are easy to find here; fresh water and prey are harder.
strings.map.region.herd_trail.description: Generations of hooves have worn a broad trail through the steppe. Herd scent draws hunters here, and wolves follow the same route.
strings.map.region.tallgrass.description: Tall grass closes over narrow animal trails, broken by shallow seasonal pools. You can hear movement long before you see what made it.
strings.map.region.south_range.description: Open grassland rolls towards the dry southern hills. There is prey to follow, but wolf tracks cross the game trails.
strings.map.region.twin_forks.description: Two channels of the Greywater meet among low banks and wet grass. Prey comes to drink, while spring water spreads beyond the familiar crossings.
strings.map.region.reedbank.description: Thick reeds shelter geese and hide the edge of the marsh. The ground is soft underfoot, and rising water can cut across the trails.
strings.map.region.fog_paths.description: Narrow tracks weave through pines and wet hollows. Fog hides the next turn, and familiar ground can look strange on the way back.
strings.map.region.west_spur.description: A wooded rise follows the western edge of the Vale. Pine roots hold pockets of dry ground above the damp forest floor.
strings.map.region.mere_shore.description: Reeds grow across old paw-worn trails beside the lake. Open water draws prey close, but the spring ice weakens along the shore.
strings.map.region.island_mere.description: Low islands break the Mere into reed-fringed channels. Geese gather among them, beyond shallows that change with the water.
strings.map.region.east_saddle.description: An exposed saddle links the heights above the lake and the southern hills. Loose rock and steep snowfields make the crossing slow.
strings.map.region.claw_gorge.description: Narrow ledges run between walls scored by bear claws. There is little room to turn when something larger comes along the path.
strings.map.region.wolf_run.description: A hard-worn trail threads through dry wolf country. Fresh prints overlap the old, and scent marks cover the stones along the way.
strings.map.region.camel_ridge.description: Camel trails cross the dry ridge on their way to summer grazing. Water is scarce, and wolf scent reaches up from the neighbouring hills.

playStyles.name: Story
playStyles.description: A gentler Ice Age for living the tale. Hunts succeed more often, wounds heal fast, and the pride's daily work is handled for you.

playStyles.name: Standard
playStyles.description: Survival and story in balance. Spend your first spring alone: hunt, rest, travel, and meet the cats of the Vale.

playStyles.name: Sim
playStyles.description: The Ice Age at its harshest. Prey is scarce in winter, meat spoils, wounds can fester, and every cat's hunger, den, and bloodline is yours to manage.
